text:
Narrative Arc:

Beginning: Sophia, an aspiring musician, struggles with severe stage fright that prevents her from performing and sharing her musical talents with others.

Climax: After being inspired and encouraged by encounters with seasoned artists, Sophia faces her greatest challenge at a major music festival. This is the pivotal moment where she must confront her fear head-on.

Resolution: Sophia overcomes her stage fright and delivers a powerful, resonant performance at the festival. This success marks the beginning of her rising career and resolves her internal conflict.

Priority Question Answer: Glass is the transparent material commonly used to make windows.
